text:
eli: quick heads-up — nightly shows a 6-12% QPS drop vs canary on short sequences when KV is interleaved and fused Flash kernels should've been used. nvprof/nsys traces show an unexpected memcpy. anyone else seeing this?

maya: hmm. which model/seq/dtype? int8 or fp16?

eli: llama-2-13b, mostly seq=32, mixed traffic. interleaved KV layout (B x L x H x head_dim interleaved) with fp16 and some int8 quant experiments. kernel selector seems to prefer a paged-flash path and triggers a copy for alignment.

samir: can you paste selector log + small profiler snippet?

eli: pasted below — very small but consistent across traces:

```text
KERNEL_SELECT: batch=6 seq=32 -> selected=flash_paged_v1 (fallback)
PROF: memcpy: 8.1ms, attn_kernel: 1.2ms, total: 12.3ms
```

maya: that memcpy dominating indicates stride/alignment mismatch. fused kernel wants contiguous per-head layout; our interleaved stride fails the "is_contiguous" check and forces a staging buffer. stride in profiler looked like 512*bytes per head.

neha: +1. also see batching heuristics come into play — autoscaler sometimes splits big requests into small batches so kernel_pref picks lower-latency but lower-throughput path. combined effect explains the hit.

ops-bot: :information_source: rolled back nightly at 2026-03-15T09:12Z due to perf regression alerts.

samir: test suggestion: run microbench A/B interleaved vs separate-KV (heads contiguous) and vary batch sizes [1,2,4,8,16] x seq [8,32,128]. capture with `nsys` and save selector logs.

eli: quick A/B I ran earlier: separate-KV (heads contiguous) restored ~9% QPS and removed the memcpy step. canary showing improved p50 tokens.

maya: created INF-7342 linking selector tweak + canary config. assigning samir for kernel-selector patch, neha for batching policy tuning.

samir: ack — i'll run the microbench and dump csvs into the ticket. will also try relaxing the alignment check to accept stride multiples of 128 bytes and measure memcpy break-even.

neha: i'll prototype a batching policy that avoids splitting for interleaved-KV workflows and add a gate in rollout. also noting dtype: bf16 vs fp16 change the alignment math — adding note to INF-7342.

eli: thanks all. tagging @samir @neha. :thumbsup:
